info.title: Clinic and Scheduling API
info.description: Own appointment/Spa, records, images and status history. Current role and owner scope verified through Core. Projection search is eventually consistent; related rows use authorized Core lookup. Core outage fails closed.

503.description: Unavailable or bounded fallback full. No empty-success response.

get.description: Paginated JSON envelope. Rows use a stable order with id as a tie-breaker. Count, filters and page share a Repeatable Read transaction. related contains only relations needed by this page. Counts are independent of the selected status/page. Clinic projection mode is eventual without a read token. Owner/existence authorization always uses current source. Unbilled queries remain authoritative. Invalid/expired read tokens return 422 with code CLINIC_READ_TOKEN_INVALID; actor/role/scope mismatch returns 403. Retry only the GET without a token and with authoritative consistency after token expiry. Bounded whole-query fallback may return 503 with Retry-After.

get.description: Split Clinic only. Appointment DATE and current status; cancelled/no_show included in total. Inclusive period up to 366 days, adjacent equal-day previous period in the same read-only snapshot. Rates are ratios or null; totalDeltaPercent is percent or null when previous=0. Unknown/repeated/non-string parameters return 422. Clients cannot select a reader. Source/cached mode is server-configured; cache TTL is absolute 5s. Does not enable projected appointment lists.
